name: mpv
description: Scriptable cross-platform media player with high-quality video output and broad format support.
reason: Powerful lightweight playback and automation-friendly configuration.

name: Navidrome
description: Lightweight self-hosted music server compatible with Subsonic clients.
reason: A mature local-first alternative to hosted music libraries.

name: qBittorrent
description: Cross-platform BitTorrent client with search, RSS, scheduling, and a web interface.
reason: Widely adopted desktop and headless download manager.

name: Sunshine
description: Self-hosted low-latency game and desktop streaming host for Moonlight clients.
reason: Popular open game-streaming host with useful GPU and network setup.

name: Moonlight PC
description: Desktop client for low-latency game and remote-desktop streaming.
reason: Completes a practical open-source streaming pair with Sunshine.

name: RetroArch
description: Unified frontend for emulators, game engines, media players, and Libretro cores.

name: Playnite
description: Windows game-library manager unifying multiple stores, emulators, and metadata providers.
reason: Useful for consolidating fragmented PC game libraries.

name: Audiobookshelf
description: Self-hosted audiobook, ebook, and podcast server with progress synchronization.
reason: Strong personal-media use case with active mobile and server support.

name: calibre
description: Comprehensive ebook library manager, reader, converter, editor, and device synchronizer.
reason: Long-lived and highly capable ebook workflow.

name: Music Assistant
description: Local music-library manager connecting streaming services to networked speakers.
reason: Actively released home-audio orchestration with broad provider support.

name: Bevy
description: Data-driven two-dimensional and three-dimensional game engine built in Rust.
reason: Leading modern open-source Rust game engine.

name: OpenTTD
description: Open transport simulation game with multiplayer, mods, and cross-platform support.
reason: Mature playable project with extensive configuration and modding.

name: OpenRCT2
description: Open-source recreation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 with modern platform support.

name: Luanti

name: Mindustry

name: AFFiNE

name: Stirling PDF

name: Excalidraw

name: Docmost
description: Collaborative wiki and documentation platform with real-time editing and diagrams.

name: Actual Budget

name: ERPNext

name: diagrams.net Desktop

name: Twenty

name: PocketBase

name: FreshRSS

name: Discourse

name: SearXNG

name: Umami

name: Plausible Analytics

name: Portainer

name: Coolify

name: Gitleaks

name: Node-RED
